title: Variable bound for the acceptance formula
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The variable count of its acceptance formula is at most the width $w(n,s)$, where $w(n,s)$ is the width assigned to encodings of configurations for these parameters.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean symbols
